items.summary: Greptile's new tool, , tackles this bottleneck by moving from static code analysis to active runtime execution.

items.title: Greptile
items.summary: By reading the code and then running it, mimics the review and QA pipelines that real engineering teams build and automates the gruntwork of validation.

items.title: Semantic Code Graph
items.summary: That context comes from Greptile's underlying . Before running any code, Greptile parses the entire repository to extract and map directories, files, functions, variables, and classes.

items.title: Greptile CLI
items.summary: Developers don't have to wait for a GitHub PR to get codebase-aware feedback. The allows engineers to run a full repository review locally in the terminal.

items.title: Brex integrated Greptile
items.summary: to navigate their massive, 8-year-old monorepo with high precision and low noise. By catching what human reviewers easily miss, the platform helped Brex ship features 30% faster. CTO James Reggio officially called it "the only AI reviewer that doesn't annoy the s**t out of me."

items.title: catching bugs in the wild
items.summary: We can also see TREX runtime validation . In the "workos/oagen" repository, Greptile caught a correctness bug leaking sibling models and breaking a selected-only contract.
